title: Duterte defense: Killings in PH not ‘crimes vs humanity’
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Defense lawyers for former President Rodrigo Duterte said that even if there were thousands of killings committed in his war on drugs, he should be tried in the Philippines, as…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defense lawyers for former President Rodrigo Duterte said that even if there were thousands of killings committed in his war on drugs, he should be tried in the Philippines, as the charge of crimes against humanity against him would not stand under the Rome Statute, which established the International Criminal Court (ICC).
